head: working-tree
subject: CDS outlier detection projection
change: Cluster.outlier_detection (field 19) is now decoded and projected into the SharedChannel's outlier_detection_experimental policy. Interval, base/max ejection time, max ejection percent, success-rate stdev/enforcement/minimum-hosts/request-volume and failure-percentage threshold/enforcement/minimum-hosts/request-volume are mapped. Consecutive-5xx, gateway-failure and local-origin controls, ejection jitter, active-health-check unejection and monitors fail closed when enabled. The generated policy is validated by the ordinary ServiceConfig parser before publication.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/cds/tests.zig 'gRPC CDS projects outlier detection into the channel policy' decodes all mapped fields, parses the generated loadBalancingConfig, and asserts the resulting outlier wrapper and round-robin child.

notes: CDS outlier detection now covers the gRPC-mappable subset. LRS automatic scheduling, authority-specific control planes, SDS/certificate providers and non-router HTTP filters remain open.
